sentence: She usually goes shopping on Saturday mornings
explanation: Los adverbios de frecuencia como <usually> van antes del verbo principal.

sentence: They often play tennis after work
explanation: Los adverbios de frecuencia van antes del verbo principal: <often play>.

sentence: He always takes the bus to the office
explanation: <Always> va antes del verbo principal: <always takes>.

sentence: We sometimes eat out at a restaurant on Fridays
hint: Subject + adverb + phrasal verb + place + time
explanation: <Sometimes> va antes del verbo principal. <Eat out> significa comer en un restaurante.

sentence: I never drink coffee in the evening
explanation: <Never> va antes del verbo principal: <never drink>.

sentence: She is currently learning to play the guitar
hint: Subject + is + adverb + verb-ing + infinitive + object
explanation: Presente continuo con adverbio: <is currently learning>.

sentence: They usually have breakfast at eight o'clock
explanation: Los adverbios de frecuencia van antes del verbo principal: <usually have>.

sentence: He rarely watches television during the week
explanation: <Rarely> va antes del verbo principal: <rarely watches>.

sentence: We always walk to school together in the morning
hint: Subject + adverb + verb + destination + manner + time
explanation: <Always> va antes del verbo principal: <always walk>.

sentence: She often reads a book before going to bed
hint: Subject + adverb + verb + object + time clause
explanation: <Often> va antes del verbo principal: <often reads>.

sentence: I sometimes go for a walk in the park after lunch
hint: Subject + adverb + verb + activity + place + time
explanation: <Go for a walk> es una expresión común para referirse a caminar como ejercicio.

sentence: He usually does his homework before dinner
explanation: <Usually> va antes del verbo principal: <usually does>.

sentence: We are meeting some friends for dinner tonight
explanation: El presente continuo se usa para planes ya organizados en el futuro cercano.

sentence: She occasionally goes to the gym before work
explanation: <Occasionally> es un adverbio de frecuencia que va antes del verbo principal.

sentence: They are planning to visit their grandparents this weekend
hint: Subject + be + verb-ing + to + infinitive + object
explanation: <Be planning to> se usa para hablar de intenciones futuras.

sentence: I usually check my emails first thing in the morning
hint: Subject + adverb + verb + object + time expression
explanation: <First thing in the morning> significa lo primero que haces al despertar.

sentence: He hardly ever cooks dinner during the week
hint: Subject + adverb phrase + verb + object + time
explanation: <Hardly ever> significa casi nunca; va antes del verbo principal.

sentence: We are having a party next Saturday evening
explanation: El presente continuo con expresión de tiempo futuro indica un plan organizado.

sentence: She generally arrives at the office before nine
explanation: <Generally> es un sinónimo de <usually> y también va antes del verbo principal.

sentence: They are getting ready to leave for the airport
hint: Subject + be + verb-ing + adjective + to + infinitive
explanation: <Get ready> significa prepararse para hacer algo.
